notes.title: Version 2.0 Multiplayer Features
notes.content:
[h1]Version 2.0 brings many new features to the game![/h1]
Now you have the option to play Action Clicker online, create lobbies or join other players.
Design your lobby according to your wishes! For example, set the round duration or difficulty.
Meet the three new opponents in multiplayer mode! Use the new emojis to interact with your opponent and improve your multiplayer stats.
The big changes are:
[olist]
[*]Multiplayer mode
[*]Create and manage lobbies
[*]Three new opponents exclusively for the multiplayer
[*]New emojis for multiplayer
[*]Multiplayer statistics
[*]New effects for the multiplayer
[/olist]
There are also a few minor changes and bug fixes!
[olist]
[*]Ability to exit the game from the main menu
[*]Personalization bug fixes
[*]Improvement of the user interface
[/olist]
